blocks.text: Mukhtalif naliyon mein khoon ki raftar (velocity) mukhtalif hoti hai. Yeh aorta mein sab se zyada hoti hai (450-500 mm fi second), phir arteries aur arterioles mein kam hoti jati hai aur capillaries mein sab se kam hoti hai (taqreeban 1 mm fi second; kitab mein “01 mm/sec” chhapa hai). Venules, veins aur vena cavae mein raftar phir barh jati hai (250-300 mm fi second). Raftar ki yeh tabdeeli naliyon ke kul cross section (tamam naliyon ke kate hue hisse ka mila kar raqba) badalne ki wajah se hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Graph jis ke y-axis par khoon ki raftar (mm/sec) 0 se 500 tak aur x-axis par aorta, arteries, arterioles, capillaries, venules, veins aur vena cava ki rangeen pattiyan hain. Peeli lakeer aorta mein qareeb 480 se shuru ho kar arteries aur arterioles mein girti hai, capillaries mein taqreeban sifar ho jati hai, phir venules aur veins mein barh kar vena cava mein qareeb 270 tak aati hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Capillaries ka majmui cross-section sab se zyada hai, is liye wahan khoon sab se aahista chalta hai aur tabadle ke liye waqt milta hai. Textbook ka '01 mm/sec' asal mein taqreeban 1 mm/sec hai.
